meta.description: Registry for derivation closure failure modes and blocking conditions.

failure_modes.name: evidence_mismatch
failure_modes.description: Linked evidence does not support the formal requirements of the derivation step.

failure_modes.name: incomplete_step_derivation
failure_modes.description: One or more formal predicates required for the step remain unproven or unmapped.

failure_modes.name: unresolved_primitive_dependency
failure_modes.description: Derivation step depends on a primitive or operator with undefined symbolic form.

failure_modes.name: closure_leakage
failure_modes.description: The derivation step allows for process states to map outside the declared closure domain.

failure_modes.name: unverified_equivalence_assumption
failure_modes.description: Derivation assumes an equivalence relation that lacks formal property verification.
